system.description:
Artefact (22 cards in a case). Announce how many cards you will draw, then draw them; each takes effect at once, and the deck vanishes after the last.

  • Sun: +1 to an attribute of your choice, to 22.
  • Moon: 1d3 castings of wish.
  • Star: +2 to one attribute, to 22.
  • Comet: defeat the next foe alone and gain a level.
  • Throne: a stronghold of your own.
  • Key: a magic weapon.
  • Knight: a 4th-level Fighter serves you.
  • Gem: 25 gems worth 500 gp each.
  • Fates: undo one event.
  • Vizier: the answer to one question.
  • Jester: draw two more.
  • Fool: lose one level, draw again.
  • Euryale: Disadvantage on all saves until a god lifts it.
  • Ruin: lose all your wealth.
  • Rogue: an ally turns on you.
  • Talons: every magic item you own vanishes.
  • Balance: your Outlook reverses.
  • Flames: a fiend becomes your enemy.
  • Idiot: lose 1d4 Intelligence for good.
  • Skull: an avatar of death attacks you, alone.
  • Donjon: you are imprisoned.
  • The Void: your soul is torn away, held captive elsewhere.

Monsters & Treasure, Artefacts. Its save DC is 20 unless the entry says otherwise.
